settings_fingerprint.overrides_note: This producer measures the files of the pipeline and not the market. No markout is computed here, so every scoring field of this block states what settings.py declares and says nothing about this artifact. The inputs list is empty on purpose and the reason is the one build_declarations.py calls a walker: this producer reads every artifact and every file of three directory trees, so naming them as inputs would put thousands of edges in the graph and say less than the population field above already says

mode.what_this_file_describes: this repository, the data directories the acquisition log names as the home of data on this machine, and the documents of the parent workspace that artifacts of this repository declare as inputs, each named one at a time under search_areas below
mode.what_this_file_does_not_describe: everything else on the machine this ran on. The workspace around this repository is NOT walked in this mode, so no count in this file is a census of a local disk, and a file's absence from this register is not evidence that the file is absent from that disk. What is claimed here is what the declared areas hold, and nothing about what they do not cover
mode.the_other_mode: the second mode, run as data_register.py --full-local-census, replaces the third area with a walk of the whole workspace. It answers a question about one machine, and nothing this repository ships is built from it

search_areas.why: this repository: every artifact, every script and every derived intermediate a run leaves beside its producer

../02_data, whose six data directories the acquisition log names as the home of data on this machine, and the acquisition log itself. It sits outside this repository because a raw day is gigabytes; a clone without it gets a register over the tree and this area marked absent

the documents of the parent workspace that artifacts of this repository declare as inputs, named one at a time rather than found by walking the workspace: a walk reports every file of one working copy, and the files it adds are not files this pipeline reads

declarations.predicate: a .json file of this repository whose top level carries a _meta block with an inputs list, and one edge per record of that list. undeclared_census.population: every file under ../02_data, whose six directories the acquisition log calls the home of data on this machine

what_each_bucket_means.declared_by_name: an artifact names this file as an input
what_each_bucket_means.declared_by_content: no artifact names it, but its bytes carry an identity some artifact recorded, so it is the same file under another name
what_each_bucket_means.inside_a_declared_directory: an artifact declares the directory it sits in as its input, which is what a producer that read a whole cache records
what_each_bucket_means.a_day_of_a_declared_remote_prefix: an artifact declares the remote prefix this day was pulled from, so the file is the local copy of a declared object
what_each_bucket_means.undeclared: nothing in this repository claims this file. This is the bucket the register exists to print

calibration.how_the_fixtures_are_made: both are derived at run time from artifact.py, the module this file imports, so neither can go stale and neither names a live defect of the tree. The first carries that file's true sha256 and a recorded address the file is not at; the second carries the same size with one byte of the content flipped, an identity nothing on disk can hold

must_fire.expected: found, off the recorded path, and the true address named

the_census_of_undeclared_files.how_the_fixtures_are_made: two paths under a data directory are put through bucket_of, the same sorter the census runs on every real file. One is named by nothing and sits in a directory named by nothing; the other carries a name some artifact declares

what_each_count_counts.n_found_off_the_recorded_path: the input resolved by hash, and no copy carrying that identity sits at the address its reader would have resolved. This is the count a path-based instrument would report as missing files
what_each_count_counts.n_absent: no file in the declared search area carries any identity recorded for this name, or no identity was ever recorded and no file bears the name
what_each_count_counts.bytes_hashed: the bytes this run actually read, against bytes_in_the_area which is what a sweep of everything would have read
